_schema_note: relevant_chunks intentionally use expected_chunk_keywords (matched against retrieved chunk text) rather than fabricated stable chunk IDs like 'chunk_12': this project's ingestion pipeline (backend/app/services/chunking_service.py) assigns a fresh random UUID to every chunk on every upload, so a chunk-ID-keyed gold label would silently go stale the moment a document is re-uploaded or re-chunked (e.g. after a chunk_size/overlap config change). Keyword-in-text matching is the same relevance definition backend/eval/run_eval.py already uses for its own P@5/Recall@5/MRR (see precision_at_k/recall_at_k/reciprocal_rank/hit_at_k, run_eval.py:187-236) and is the practical, honest choice for a project with UUID-per-chunk ingestion. relevant_document_hint is a human-readable label (not a UUID) for the same reason.

cases.query: What is a project according to the document?
What is a Work Breakdown Structure?
What is a Business Case in project management?
expected_facts: documents feasibility/economic justification for a project

cases.query: If a project's CPI is greater than 1, is that good or bad?
expected_facts: CPI > 1 means the project is under budget (favourable)

cases.query: What organic remedy is recommended for apple scab?
What is the chemical treatment for cherry powdery mildew?
expected_facts: a chemical active ingredient is specified for cherry powdery mildew

cases.query: what is a project?
cases.note: lowercase, no question mark, minimal phrasing of rag_001 — tests robustness to casing/punctuation, not new content

cases.query: wbs??
cases.note: acronym-only, no full words — tests whether retrieval/generation still resolves WBS without the spelled-out term in the query

cases.query: What's the treatment for scab?
expected_facts: at least one crop's scab entry (e.g. apple scab) should be surfaced
cases.note: does not name a crop — 'scab' alone is ambiguous (apple scab is the only scab entry in this corpus, but the query doesn't disambiguate); a wrong-crop guess or a request for clarification are both defensible, a fabricated crop-specific answer without hedging is not

cases.query: Is that ratio good or bad?
cases.note: no antecedent — 'that ratio' refers to nothing in a fresh (no-history) request; expected safe behavior is a clarifying question or a fallback, not a hallucinated guess at which ratio was meant

cases.query: Compare CPI and SPI and explain what it means if CPI is favourable but SPI is unfavourable.
expected_facts: CPI concerns cost performance, SPI concerns schedule performance
favourable CPI + unfavourable SPI means under budget but behind schedule
cases.note: requires combining facts likely spread across two source chunks (CPI definition + SPI definition), not answerable from a single chunk

cases.query: What is the rare agronomic term 'necrotrophic pathogen' and does it apply to any disease in this corpus?
cases.note: the exact term 'necrotrophic' does not appear in the corpus (only 'Pathogen Type: Fungal' is recorded); correct behavior is answering from the closest available fact (pathogen type) or declining, never inventing a definition sourced from outside the corpus and presenting it as document-grounded

cases.query: What is the current weather forecast for Delhi?
cases.note: not answerable from any indexed document; correct behavior is the fallback/decline reply, not a fabricated answer

cases.query: Summarize the plot of the last Marvel movie.
What is the treatment for citrus greening disease (HLB)?
cases.note: a real, named crop disease NOT present in this corpus's crop/disease table (verified against the indexed corpus at audit time: apple/bell pepper/blueberry/cherry/corn/grape/orange/peach/potato/raspberry/soybean/squash/strawberry/tomato only, no citrus greening entry) — the harder out-of-corpus case: plausible-sounding and topically adjacent, so a model that pattern-matches on domain rather than checking evidence is likely to fabricate a treatment

cases.query: Looking at the figure in the document, what does the bar chart show happening to quarterly revenue across the four quarters?
cases.note: carried over from eval/dataset_v3.json; depends on a specific multimodal test PDF with an embedded bar-chart image remaining indexed. If that document is no longer in vector_store/, this case will legitimately fail retrieval — reported as-is, not adjusted after the fact.

cases.query: According to the table, what is the 2023 revenue figure for the North region?
cases.note: carried over from eval/dataset_v3.json — see rag_016's note on dependency.

cases.query: Based on the scanned page of the report, what is the plant species shown in the figure and which disease does it exhibit?
cases.note: carried over from eval/dataset_v3.json — see rag_016's note on dependency. Requires vision_qa_enabled.

cases.query: This document's appendix contains a column chart labeled 'Q4 growth by segment'. What is the tallest segment's label in that chart?
cases.note: carried over from eval/dataset_v3.json — see rag_016's note on dependency.

cases.query: What does a favourable SPI mean?
What is a Stakeholder Register used for?
What organic remedy works for corn gray leaf spot?
How should a healthy blueberry crop be maintained organically?
Which crop and disease pairing in the corpus uses copper octanoate, and what pathogen type is it treating?
cases.note: requires the model to identify which specific row a named chemical belongs to, not just recognize the chemical name

cases.query: wat does WBS men in pm and also tell me is CPI grater then 1 gud
cases.note: poorly worded, misspelled, two-part compound question — tests robustness to noisy real-world input, not corpus coverage
empty query — malformed-input edge case; expected safe behavior, not a crash
single-character query with no extractable content

cases.query: What organic remedy is used for cedar apple rust?
What's the best treatment?
cases.note: no crop/disease named at all — maximally ambiguous within the agronomy domain; only acceptable answers are a clarifying question or an honest fallback

cases.query: According to the HR interview guide, what projects does the candidate list as prior work?
cases.note: a third, distinct real document in the live corpus (contains real personal/career information about the repository owner) — included to test cross-document retrieval precision (the store also contains PMP and agronomy content that must NOT be what gets retrieved for this query) rather than to make claims about the individual; treat expected_facts as corpus-presence checks only
